name: Nanami Wataru
source: The protagonist who due to some family circumstances ended up transferring into the arts boarding school Kurisaki Academy. He is often misunderstood because of his sharp eyes, and whenever he tries solving these misunderstandings, he often causes even more of them to happen. Despite this fact, Wataru is quite an ordinary boy for his age. Though he has given up on being an artist, he seems to be hiding some kind of tremendous potential inside him...
